pages.text: Each side has 9 rules, plus 9 per Filter upgrade. A stack matching any $(thing)Block$() rule never passes. If there are $(thing)Allow$() rules it must match one of them. With only Block rules, everything else passes.$(br2)Click the Allow/Block chip on a rule to switch it.
Add a rule by shift-clicking an item in your inventory, by clicking the list with an item in hand, or with $(thing)+ Add filter$(). Right-click a rule to remove it, click it to open the rule editor.
